name: thebe-site
description: The bilingual portal for Thebe and Thebe Core.

scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix marketing ci && npm --prefix documentation ci
scripts.build:docs: npm run sync:core-docs && npm --prefix documentation run build
scripts.build: npm run build:marketing && npm run build:docs && node scripts/compose-release.mjs
scripts.check: npm --prefix marketing run check && npm --prefix documentation run check && node --check scripts/compose-release.mjs && node --check scripts/sync-core-docs.mjs
